_comment: PD-SAFE FOLD CARD - PERF ARM, OFF (3 h, 63 sta, DOY-129, cold).
PURPOSE: close the ONE number still owed by the network.carry_invariant_pd_safe
promotion row (docs/CONFIG_promotion_ledger.md, 'STILL OWED: fold_minv_ms delta
< 25 % was never reported'), on the CURRENT VS2026 toolchain.  The archived
pdfix_off/pdfix_on pair measured it at +51.4 % on the Aug-3 exe, but that predates
the 2026-08-12 migration and CLAUDE.md's standing rule is regenerate, not re-grade.
SOLE FUNCTIONAL DELTA vs _ft63_pdperf_on.json: network.carry_invariant_pd_safe.
Everything else is inherited from _ft63_pdfix_off.json -> _ft63_churn_base.json.
WHY PRODUCT + SNAPSHOT OUTPUT ARE DISABLED HERE (and identically in the ON arm):
this is a TIMING measurement.  Product emission and the 3600 s snapshot writes are
I/O outside the fold bracket that add machine-load jitter to a number whose bar is
25 %.  Disabling both in BOTH arms keeps the A/B fair and the box quieter.  It also
avoids C:/GnssProcessor/runs/pdfix_off/ which no longer exists (runs/ was archived
to D: on 2026-08-12).  An empty state_snapshot_path additionally means
networkSnapshotFingerprint is never computed (NetworkRunContext.cpp:559 guards on
!snap_path.empty()), so the FINGERPRINTED pd_safe knob cannot strand anything -
both arms are fresh cold convergence by construction.
DURATION IS LOAD-BEARING - DO NOT SHORTEN.  Measured on the archived pair: at 300 s
the same single knob reads +18.6 % (PASS) because the OFF arm only trips 16.10 % of
the carried dimension; at 3 h it reads +51.4 % (FAIL) at 85.24 %.  The giant joint
lane block only goes indefinite by ~ep0122.  A short arm manufactures a false PASS,
and +18.6 % is itself inside the measured 11-epoch noise floor (ten archived runs
with byte-identical network_solution.csv spread 641-902 ms, CV 11.9 %).
NOTE: network.max_duration_s is a PHANTOM key - the loader reads only
processing.max_duration_s (GnssConfigLoad.cpp:506).  Change duration THERE.
READ THE NUMBER FROM (NetworkTeardown.cpp:238-244, run-end, once per run):
Network (D0)   foldDdPriors: per-station-loop ... | M-inverse <N> ms ... | GMG^T ...
The delta is UNINTERPRETABLE without the INC-0 census line from this OFF arm:
'N block-epoch(s) and M row-epoch(s) (P %) folded INERTLY on a failed PD screen'.
ddMiddleInverseLegacy (NetworkNormalEquations.cpp:170-176) sets M = Zero and returns
WITHOUT calling inverseFromLdlt, so every inert block-epoch is an O(K^3) explicit
inverse this arm never performed.  Normalize by inverses actually done, or the
'< 25 %' bar is measuring work-volume, not arithmetic overhead.
